about: CPUID (family-model-stepping, as a microcode update's header and its file name write it) to the processors sold with it. An X in a CPUID stands for any one hexadecimal digit. The list is the source's and is not complete; a CPUID can appear in more than one entry. sSpec lists the article's codes and those added from sSpecSources; sSpecSource says, for each added code, which.
